name: Masood Azhar
real_life_parallel: Jaish-e-Mohammed founder; released IC-814 1999; Pulwama mastermind; Bahawalpur strike target

biography.background: Founder of Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM), released in Kandahar exchange (IC-814, 1999). Mastermind of Pulwama attack (2019). HQ at Bahawalpur Markaz. Brother Ibrahim Athar was IC-814 hijacker. Son Hammad Azhar briefly arrested 2019.
biography.ic_814: Released December 1999; founded JeM weeks later
biography.sindoor_target: Bahawalpur Markaz hit during Operation Sindoor May 2025; brother Abdul Rauf Asghar (operational head) reportedly killed
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: Pulwama architect. Part 4: Sindoor target; family killed in strikes.
